rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or above it, or the printed item number on its row. Money amounts pair the 12-slot peso comb with the 2-slot centavo comb directly right (money_joins); the 2-slot is the centavo comb for items 15-26 and Part IV 31-61. Items 1, 3, 5, 6, 13 and 14 Yes/No or option pairs take xbox_joins (box immediately left of the printed option; the first layout key of a Yes/No pair is Yes). Schedules 1, 3 and 4 print two rows each with no row number: the layout's rows (10/11, 0/1) take them in order under the column headers. Item 4 return period dates print through date_joins; item 10 over both lines, the page 2 TIN and the schedule Period Covered cells print from derived: keys of Form2550QDraft::to_print_field_map. Stamped TIN and branch combs (name=) take no join. Since #113 every value the print map carries has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason.
